dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shapes exhibit high-contrast light perimeters surrounding dark centers. The gradient is sharp at the outer edge, with a more diffused transition towards the interior of the structures, particularly evident in the mid-flank cluster.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of small, dark-intensity solid pixels are visible near the anterior base of the flipper. Larger, more sparse high-intensity light-colored pixel aggregates are distributed along the dorsal midline, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent circular annuli in the mid-lateral region form an approximately linear arrangement, while a fourth, more posterior annulus creates a triangular relationship with the mid-flank group, forming an internal angle of approximately 140 degrees.
